channel.title: In The Beginning
channel.description: Walking through the Bible from page one, story by story. Caleb reads each section from the King James Bible and talks through it in plain language, ending with a short prayer. New episodes on weekdays.

item.title: In The Beginning #1: Let There Be Light (Genesis 1, Part 1)
item.description: Caleb opens the Bible at page one and walks Genesis chapter one slowly, a section at a time from the King James with plain talk in between: God there before anything, light in the dark, the sky stretched out, dry land and green things, and the two great lights. Verses one through nineteen, days one through four.
